summary: T3 rework for R2 round 2 (target 4ab6ce2c). mapping.rs only: painted text now publishes a WidgetType::Label AccessKit node from `text()` while the decorative glyphs stay unlabelled and the D-pad tile keeps its label, with a kittest test that flips two bindings onto one PhysicalKey and asserts the footer status flips both ways by label; and the duplicated trailing line of the resolve_dpad doc comment is deleted while the correct `!physical` sentence and the code stay as they were. risks: Merge order: mapping.rs imports theme::DPAD_GUIDE_DOT, DPAD_ACTIVE_GLOW, DPAD_ACTIVE_DOT_SHADOW, DPAD_IDLE_DOT_SHADOW and DPAD_IDLE_DOT, which exist on agent/worker-1 (35d5343) but not on the previously reviewed integration tree. T2's token commit must be in the merge before this branch.

Label nodes carry the localized string (`content` is already the localized text), so any label-driven suite is language-dependent until the accessible-name localization policy is decided; that policy is still open and is not changed here.

Branch limitation: this branch does not register the modules and has no egui_kittest dev-dependency, so no in-tree command compiles T3. All T3 execution evidence comes from the scratch harness at %TEMP%/kilo/t3scratch, which mirrors this worktree's src, registers the modules, copies agent/worker-1's theme.rs read-only and appends the dev-dependency (sync.ps1 is in that directory). It is outside the repo and not committed.

Deferred consumer migration: mapping.rs still renders the Restore action through its private `secondary_button`. When Worker 1's shared outlined action lands, this call site must migrate so the two cards do not drift; `secondary_button` and `Icon`/`paint_icon` are still private to mapping.rs, and T4's bare egui::Button remains the other half of R2's medium.

Secondary-button icon ink stays at the Iced behavior (Restore glyph fixed at slate-600) - a deviation R2 round 2 accepted; if that judgement is ever reversed, the change is one call site plus inverting the shape-level test.
Still open and NOT solved by this slice: the font-weight strategy (keycap.rs keeps the double-stamp approximation), long-keycap-label hover-scroll, and the pulsing capture banner.

Native visual acceptance remains pending as docs/architecture/verification.md records; the kittest tests cover semantics, painted text colour, painted stroke colour and now the published text labels, not the whole rendered layout.
